title: NFLPA issues statement on comments made by line judge Jeff Seeman to Cardinals tight end Trey McBride

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFLPA issues statement on comments made by line judge Jeff Seeman to Cardinals tight end Trey McBride
sources.description: During Sunday's game between the Cardinals and the Giants, CBS camera caught an interaction between line judge Jeff Seeman and Arizona tight end Trey McBride.
